methods.notes: Advertises the Nordic UART service and a "MIscooterXXXX" name. The same NUS service is used by many devices, so confirm with a valid 55 AA reply.

device.name: Xiaomi Mijia M365 E-Scooter (BLE)
device.notes:
The Xiaomi M365 (and the ESC/BMS shared with Ninebot-built variants) is the most reverse-engineered e-scooter. Its BLE module is a stock Nordic UART port that bridges to a half-duplex one-wire UART bus (115200 8N1) shared by the BLE module, ESC and BMS: a client tunnels a register read/write protocol over the NUS characteristics. Fully local, no cloud.
GATT: Nordic UART service 6e400001-b5a3-f393-e0a9-e50e24dcca9e; write/RX 6e400002-...; notify/TX 6e400003-.... Advertised name "MIscooterXXXX".
FRAME: 55 AA | L | D | T | c | payload(LSB-first) | ck0 ck1, where L = payload length + 2. Checksum = (sum of bytes from L through payload) XOR 0xFFFF; ck0 low byte, ck1 high byte. Direction/address byte D: 0x20 master->ESC, 0x23 ESC->master, 0x22 master->battery, 0x25 battery->master. Command T: 0x01 read, 0x03 write.
KEY ESC REGISTERS: 0x10 serial (14-byte string), 0x17 PIN (6 bytes), 0x1A firmware (BCD, 0x0133 = v1.3.3), 0x7B KERS/regen level (0/1/2), 0x7C cruise on/off, 0x7D taillight, 0xB0 error codes, 0xB4 battery %, 0xB5 speed (m/h), 0xB7 total km (4 bytes), 0xB9 trip km x100. BATTERY/BMS (via D=0x22): 0x31 remaining mAh, 0x32 %, 0x33 current (Ax100, negative=charging), 0x34 voltage (Vx10), 0x35 cell temp (+20C offset), 0x40-0x49 per-cell mV.
ENCRYPTED VARIANT: header 55 AB (vs 55 AA plaintext); payload XOR-masked with a simple key stream (no AES/ECDH in the reference library).
SAFETY: see the security_advisory — commands are unauthenticated over BLE.

openness.notes: No vendor documentation; the protocol is fully reverse-engineered and cross-confirmed by multiple independent projects (py9b, CamiAlfa, ESP32 ports).

upstream_docs.covers: The 55 AA frame, XOR checksum, address/command bytes and the ESC/BMS register map.

security_advisory.detail: Zimperium showed that the anti-theft lock, cruise, acceleration/braking and even a malicious firmware flash execute over BLE with no on-wire authentication — the password gate is app-side only. There is no user fix; keeping the official app connected is the only mitigation noted.
security_advisory.summary: The app password is validated only in-app; all scooter commands execute over BLE without authentication, so anyone in BLE range can lock, brake, accelerate, or flash firmware.

credentials.notes: The PIN gates the official app only, not the BLE bus (see the security_advisory). There is no Wi-Fi.

factory_reset.effect: No documented BLE factory reset; the PIN and settings are register writes, not a single reset. Not transcribed here.

methods.description: Connect to the "MIscooter" NUS device, subscribe to notify char 6e400003, and write 55 AA-framed register reads/writes to 6e400002 (e.g. read 0xB4 battery %).

steps.action: Connect and subscribe to the TX characteristic (6e400003).
Write a 55 AA read of register 0xB4 to 6e400002 to get battery %.

setup.notes: No PIN is required to talk to the plaintext bus (the PIN lives at ESC register 0x17 and can be read/rewritten). Connect over BLE, subscribe to the TX characteristic, and write 55 AA-framed register commands to RX.

rejoin.notes: No network membership; a new BLE client connects independently.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The Nordic-UART UUIDs, the 55 AA frame + XOR checksum, and the register map are cross-confirmed by CamiAlfa/M365-BLE-PROTOCOL and Informatic/py9b; the unauthenticated-command issue is from the Zimperium advisory.

cruise_on.description: Enable cruise control (write register 0x7C = 1). Frame: 55 aa 04 20 03 7c 01 00 5b ff.

read_battery_percent.description: Read the 32-byte ESC status block starting at register 0xB0 (battery % is at offset 4 within the reply = register 0xB4). Frame: 55 aa 03 20 01 b0 20 0b ff.

read_serial.description: Read ESC register 0x10 (14-byte serial). Frame: 55 aa 03 20 01 10 0e bd ff.

characteristics.name: TX (notify)
characteristics.notes: 55 AA-framed replies (D=0x23 from ESC, 0x25 from battery).

services.name: Nordic UART serial bridge
services.notes: Tunnels the 55 AA register protocol. Write commands to 6e400002, read notifications on 6e400003. Frame: 55 AA L D T c payload ck0 ck1.
